newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bunker market largely steady in light trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bunker market largely steady in light trade.

text.p: North American bunker prices were largely steady late this week in light trade amid a slight gain in cargo markets but weak demand kept a lid on prices, players said Thursday.
In New York Harbor, spot 380 CST remained between $97 and $99 a tonne, unchanged from Tuesday. 180 CST was pegged $103/104.
Players said business was still going to overseas markets where prices were at better values.
"Ship owners are tanking up in Rotterdam or the Far East," said an East Coast trader.
Houston 380 CST on the Gulf Coast remained at par with the Harbor.
The West Coast was also light.
Los Angeles markets were down about $1 a tonne at between $103/105 a tonne, and 180 CST was $107/108.
